row.evidence: Saleor's docs cover staff via Dashboard invites, the staffCreate GraphQL mutation and an OpenID Connect plugin that will "Get or create user in Saleor" at sign-in; no SCIM endpoint is documented in the docs, the GraphQL schema or the pricing page.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Saleor is open source; Saleor Cloud is priced by GMV, not seats: Sandboxes free (non-commercial), Select $1599/mo (to $200K GMV), Volume $3999/mo (to $1M GMV), Enterprise negotiable; per-user fields stay null. Staff SSO is via the core OIDC plugin (JIT create, IdP-scope permission mapping); its plan availability on Cloud is not stated, so sso_plan is null. Saleor Cloud console access 'can be configured via SSO' (plan not stated). Staff CRUD, activation and permission groups are in the core GraphQL API on every deployment.

scim.notes: By absence (rule 5): no SCIM page in the docs sitemap or llms.txt index, the GraphQL schema (3.22) has no SCIM type, and the pricing page does not mention SCIM. Staff are invited in the Dashboard, created via GraphQL, or created on first OIDC sign-in.

capabilities.notes: Roles are permission groups (addGroups/removeGroups on staffUpdate). No licences; Saleor Cloud is not priced per seat.

endpoints.purpose: Update a staff user incl. isActive and permission groups

webhooks_user_events.notes: Only the event names quoted are recorded; staffUpdate/staffDelete pages list further STAFF_* events not captured here.

user_api.notes: Saleor is GraphQL-first; staff management mutations are part of the core API on every deployment, Cloud or self-hosted. Staff mutations require a user token with MANAGE_STAFF; apps (app tokens) are not allowed to run them. Base URL is per instance (not a fixed host).

okta.notes: www.okta.com/integrations/saleor/ returned 404; treated as not listed.

fallbacks.other_sync: OIDC plugin can map IdP OAuth scopes (saleor:<permission>, saleor:staff) to Saleor permissions at sign-in
